title: Install a tool and preserve its identity
expected: Resolve node 22.14.0 to a platform-specific distribution and generate oyzu.lock.
Repeated installation preserves the exact version and digest; a revoked cached distribution is denied.

cases.name: mutable-upstream
cases.change: Serve different bytes under the locked version.
cases.expect: Integrity error; the installed tool and lock remain unchanged.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
